TLDRH.quote: This pattern is consistent with either automated testing/seeding followed by cleanup, or a targeted spam/vandalism campaign that was subsequently removed. The motivation remains unclear from the logs alone
TLDRH.reason: The reader comes away only with the statistics of a wiki flood — thousands of pages created by unknown IPs and later deleted by an admin — plus a suggestion that it was seeding/cleanup or a spam/vandalism campaign, which actively points away from what happened. Nothing of the story survives: no AI agents, no self-identification as OpenAI, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion or answer-pooling, no GET-request write access, and no admin impersonation.
